verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਝਹੁ ਸੁਝਨਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਲੋਅ ਅੰਨ੍ਹੇ ਘੁਘੂ ਸੁਝੁ ਨ ਸੁਝੈ।
verses.translit_en: sujhahu sujhan tin loa a(n)nhe ghughoo sujh na sujhai|

en.bdb: With sun's light all the three worlds are visible but the blind and the owl can not see the sun.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਕਵੀ ਸੂਰਜ ਹੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਿਰਤੰਤੁ ਸੁ ਬੁਝੈ।
verses.translit_en: chakavee sooraj het hai ka(n)t milai virata(n)tu su bujhai|

en.bdb: The female ruddy sheldrake loves the sun, and meeting the beloved they tell and listen to the love story of each other.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਤਿ ਅਨ੍ਹੇਰਾ ਪੰਖੀਆਂ ਚਕਵੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਅਨ੍ਹੇਰਿ ਨ ਰੁਝੈ।
verses.translit_en: raat anheraa pa(n)kheeaa(n) chakavee chit anher na rujhai|

en.bdb: For all other birds the night is dark (and they sleep) but ruddy sheldrake's mind has no rest in that darkness (its mind is ever attued to sun).

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿੰਬ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਬਿੰਬੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭਰਤਾ ਜਾਣਿ ਸੁਜਾਣਿ ਸਮੁਝੈ।
verses.translit_en: bi(n)b a(n)dhar pratibi(n)b dhekh bharataa jaan sujaan samujhai|

en.bdb: An intellegent woman recognises her husband even by seeing his shadow in water,

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਪਛਾਵਾ ਪਵੇ ਖੂਹਿ ਡੁਬਿ ਮਰੈ ਸੀਹੁ ਲੋਇਨ ਲੁਝੈ।
verses.translit_en: dhekh pachhaavaa pave khooh ddub marai seeh loin lujhai|

en.bdb: But the foolish lion, seeing its own shadow in the well jumps in it and dies and then blames its own eyes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖੋਜੀ ਖੋਜੈ ਖੋਜੁ ਲੈ ਵਾਦੀ ਵਾਦੁ ਕਰੇਂਦੜ ਖੁਝੈ।
verses.translit_en: khojee khojai khoj lai vaadhee vaadh kare(n)dhaR khujhai|

en.bdb: The researcher discovers the import of the above description but the disputant is led astray
And expects to get cow-milk from a female elephant (which in fact is impossible).
